# TeeJay's Tech Tools

> Powersports and car dealership websites connected to inventory, stores, shopper paths, lead routing, SEO, privacy, and reporting. TeeJay Crawford is the founder.

Important notes:

- Public pages may be crawled. Utility, success, and private surfaces are excluded or noindex.
- The free audit uses public sources and does not guarantee ranking, inclusion, or citation.
- Prototype, staged, deployed, and live are separate states.
- Lead submission remains a human action.

Site references:

- [Canonical site](https://teejaystechtools.com/): Official public website.
- [XML sitemap](https://teejaystechtools.com/sitemap.xml): Complete indexable URL inventory.
- [Crawler policy](https://teejaystechtools.com/robots.txt): Public crawler access rules.
- [Contact TeeJay](https://teejaystechtools.com/contact.html): Private business inquiry form.

## Start here

- [All-in-one dealer websites](https://teejaystechtools.com/dealer-websites.html): Inventory-feed websites with search, VDPs, leads, finance, trade, service, parts, rentals, SEO, privacy, reporting, and support.
- [Powersports dealer websites](https://teejaystechtools.com/powersports-websites.html): Unit search, detail pages, sales, parts, service, and approved source mapping for powersports dealers.
- [Car dealership websites](https://teejaystechtools.com/car-dealership-websites.html): Vehicle inventory, rooftop routing, trade, finance, service, and accountable lead paths.
- [Inventory feeds and merchandising](https://teejaystechtools.com/inventory-merchandising.html): Feed health, descriptions, media and option exceptions, and dealer-controlled inventory quality.
- [Live website work](https://teejaystechtools.com/work.html): Pettus Automotive, Beck Disposal, Curtis Glass Center, Talley Tint and Customs, Get More For Your Trade, Pettus Trailers, and APG Customs.
- [Beck Disposal performance project](https://teejaystechtools.com/work/beck-disposal.html): Original-photo image optimization, style reliability, cache behavior, and privacy-aware analytics on the existing WordPress site.
- [Dealership solutions](https://teejaystechtools.com/dealerships.html): The connected dealer website system, with inventory, shopper paths, lead routing, SEO, privacy, reporting, and custom software.
- [Products](https://teejaystechtools.com/products.html): Current tools and scoped offers.
- [About TeeJay Crawford](https://teejaystechtools.com/about.html): Founder background and operating approach.

## Dealership systems

- [Inventory Merchandising Guard](https://teejaystechtools.com/inventory-merchandising.html): Guarded listing-quality operations.
- [Inventory descriptions and merchandising](https://teejaystechtools.com/inventory-descriptions.html): VIN-matched, evidence-backed vehicle descriptions and dealer-controlled review.
- [Marketing measurement](https://teejaystechtools.com/marketing-truth.html): Separately scoped campaign, destination, shopper-action, and reporting review, not built-in website ad management.
- [AutoLister / DealerLister inventory sync](https://teejaystechtools.com/autolister.html): Script-based inventory loading, source-fit checks, and operator-controlled Marketplace reconciliation for one approved dealership rooftop.
- [Reputation management](https://teejaystechtools.com/reputation-visibility.html): Exact-location review, response, listing-consistency, escalation, and public-state operations.
- [Custom dealer software](https://teejaystechtools.com/custom-dealer-software.html): Inventory applications, integrations, dashboards, workflow automation, and governed agents built around dealer operations.
- [Dealer Command System](https://teejaystechtools.com/dealer-command-system.html): Owner-facing dealership operating module.
